// The Win32 surface of photone-ipc, generated by CsWin32 into Windows.Win32.PInvoke (see NativeMethods.json).
// Internal/Kernel.cs is the only place that calls it: it adds the constants the metadata does not carry and the error helpers.

// ---- placeholders, views and the commit of a SEC_RESERVE section (DESIGN §4, §16.2) ----
VirtualAlloc2
MapViewOfFile3
VirtualAlloc
VirtualFree
UnmapViewOfFile
CreateFileMappingW
OpenFileMappingW
FILE_MAP
PAGE_PROTECTION_FLAGS
VIRTUAL_ALLOCATION_TYPE
VIRTUAL_FREE_TYPE
UNMAP_VIEW_OF_FILE_FLAGS

// ---- handles, processes, time ----
CloseHandle
DuplicateHandle
DUPLICATE_HANDLE_OPTIONS
GetCurrentProcess
GetProcessTimes
GetSystemInfo
GetTickCount64
OpenProcess
PROCESS_ACCESS_RIGHTS

// ---- signaling: named events and waits (DESIGN §9) ----
CreateEventW
SetEvent
ResetEvent
WaitForSingleObject
WaitForMultipleObjects
WAIT_EVENT
INFINITE

// ---- slow paths: a process snapshot without a handle, and the handle count of a section (DESIGN §14.3, §15.3) ----
NtQuerySystemInformation
NtQueryObject
SYSTEM_PROCESS_INFORMATION
PUBLIC_OBJECT_BASIC_INFORMATION

// ---- the Win32 error codes and NTSTATUS values the library reacts to ----
WIN32_ERROR
STATUS_INFO_LENGTH_MISMATCH
STATUS_BUFFER_TOO_SMALL
